integrity: Companion standalone verifier and 20-pair rank-three certificate are included; no external independent audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Explicit constructions apply to ranks two and n-1 for all n >= 3; complete five-point result concerns minimum number of idempotents moved, not existence of involutions at all ranks for arbitrary n. A 20-pair finite certificate is directly checked; infinite assertions are proved separately. Unindexed equivalent prior work cannot be excluded.
title: Idempotent-fixing inverse involutions at extremal ranks and a sharp five-point obstruction
